meta.title: Extend the live reverse auction to earlier than the current end

steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse auction in the buyer console.
Record the displayed current end time before attempting the invalid change.

args.message: New time cannot be less than existing

steps.note: Attempt to set the submission end to a time earlier than the current end and assert Procol refuses it with the expected message.
Verify the displayed end time did not change after the refusal.
